candidates.change_summary: Remove the assignment to balances[owner] so the owner receives no tokens during NETM initialization.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from NETM so anyone can call it and become the owner, changing token distribution.
Remove the require checking that _amount <= allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom, allowing a transfer even if allowance is insufficient.
Remove the line that decreases allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom, so the allowance is not deducted after a successful transfer.
Insert `allowed[_from][msg.sender] = 0;` before the existing allowance deduction, resetting the entire allowance to zero on every transferFrom.
Delete the entire onlyPayloadSize modifier body assertion, removing the calldata size check.
